about.text: Kalari, or kaladi, is a traditional cheese of the Dogra people of Jammu, made around Ramnagar in the Udhampur district from raw full-fat cow or buffalo milk. The curd is packed into small leaf bowls and dried in the sun, so it is dry outside and moist inside, and it is usually fried before eating.
